description: Layout streams after layout/pnr/slice.pnr.json restored the M5/M6 power grid (issue #66) and layout/lane_column.gds was re-assembled to embed it; re-attestation of attest/item2.r8.json, kept as history. The request's hand-written followpin-only power block was replaced by the klt asap7sc7p5t PDN recipe transcribed explicitly (M5 w 0.216 / p 5.4 / sp 0.312, M6 w 0.288 / p 5.376 / sp 0.096, M2<->M5 max_columns 1 ongrid {M3 M4}, M5<->M6 max_columns 1), with the M5 strap offset at 0.306 um instead of the recipe's 0.312 so every M5 strap edge lands on the deck's absolute 24 nm grid at this floorplan's core origin; the grid could not be taken from "power.preset" directly because the preset validates pdk.cell_library as asap7sc7p5t_28 while post_route_spef/sdf validate it as asap7sc7p5t_rvt (filed as 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#6029), so the recipe's explicit form was used and post-route SPEF/SDF are preserved. The P&R report now grades power delivery complete (1,016 VDD / 1,021 VSS STRIPE segments, 1,085/1,089 vias); placement is unchanged (same tied netlist, same seed, byte-identical routed netlist) and routing moved around the new straps. Pinned by sha256 of raw bytes: the assembled column and its inputs (routed slice, drawn TX/RX cells). Layout geometry only; the DRC result is the separate record under verification/drc/ (lane_column.r5.drc.run-record.json), and the LVS results are the separate records under evidence/item4-lvs/ (spec section 3). ASAP7 is predictive and nothing here is fabricated.

assembled.note: Re-assembled with `python3 layout/assemble_column.py` so the column embeds this slice stream; `--check` exits 0. The drawn TX/RX cells are unchanged, so only the embedded slice geometry moved.

pad_check.note: Re-run against the re-assembled column: status pass, 34/34 pad centres matched, layout/pad_check_record.json byte-identical to r8's. The pad layer (96/0) lives in the drawn cells, which this change does not touch.

generator.note: The routed slice is reproducible from the committed netlist and the pinned lambdapdk archive; `--check` reproduces it byte-for-byte with the restored power grid, and `--check-input` confirms the tied netlist still hashes to the report's provenance.input.content_hash (the netlist itself is unchanged by this issue).

envelope.note: The klt-produced envelope the block manifest cites for item 2; this file is the companion stream inventory.
